name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: An animated figure that counts up or down to a target with a spring easing the first time it scrolls into view, formatted with commas and optional decimals.
use: A stats section should make its numbers feel alive when it comes into view.
avoid: The value changes live: it animates only once on first view and ignores later updates.
a11y: Plain text that rewrites many times a second can make screen readers repeat values; no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three large white numbers stacked on black, each above a small grey label: a user count, a percentage and a dollar figure. The digits are tight, bold and tabular.
behaves: Each number rises from zero toward its target once it enters the viewport, decelerating into place and then staying fixed.
customise: The target value, start value, direction, delay and decimal places are props; formatting is fixed to en-US with commas.
weight: light: One span whose text is updated by a single spring value.
demo: Three stats labelled Active Users, Uptime and Revenue with values like 12,500, 99.0% and $4,820,000.
polishWhy: Clean, readable numbers with a smooth spring; the three-stat demo is plain but effective.
usage:
import { NumberTicker } from "@/components/ui/number-ticker"; export default function Demo() { return (
Active Users
% Uptime
$ Revenue
); }
